name: Unstable SMP Death Sounds - Optimized
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Orlisan
description: An optimized enhancement of BattryLeaf's mod that plays the Wither death sound when players die, fixing non-English server bugs and removing unnecessary mixins!

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: When a death message (a translated chat message whose key starts with 'death.') arrives, it plays the Wither spawn sound and logs '[UnstableSMPDeathSound - Optimized] Death Detected, Wither Spawn Sound Played'.
note: Not yet: The sound itself isn't checked, only its log line.
